title: Legal Minds, Algorithmic Decisions: How LLMs Apply Constitutional Principles in Complex Scenarios
findings: This paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion. Its primary finding is that GPT-4 tends to align with progressive legal interpretations in bioethics cases, siding more often with the applicants challenging existing laws rather than the more conservative positions of the State or the moderate stance of the Constitutional Court.
